name: TARBP2 subunit of RISC loading complex

function.text: TARBP2 is the approved symbol for TARBP2 subunit of RISC loading complex. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in double-stranded RNA binding; enzyme binding; miRNA processing.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma; Endometrial carcinoma. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: TARBP2 encodes TARBP2 subunit of RISC loading complex. Based in part on similarity, it is required for formation of the RNA induced silencing complex (RISC). It forms part of the RISC loading complex (RLC), also known as the micro-RNA (miRNA) loading complex (miRLC), which is composed of DICER1, AGO2 and TARBP2. May also play a role in the production of short interfering RNAs (siRNAs) from double-stranded RNA (dsRNA) by DICER1.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TARBP2 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, colorectal carcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma.
